description: Surface what aiponge has NOTICED about the user — the observations, recurring patterns, and wellness signal drawn from their self-model, inferred from their reflections. Read-only. Use it when the user asks "what has aiponge learned about me?", "what patterns do you see in me?", "what are my themes?", "how am I doing?", or to understand the user before suggesting actions. This is the INFERRED picture, not a diagnosis; for the user's explicitly-set settings (audio preferences, language, account) use get_profile instead. Returns empty sections for a new user with little history.
name: get_insights
title: What aiponge has learned about me
